purpose: One deterministic integrity fingerprint over the complete canonically reviewed Shine estate at a shared audit asOf timestamp.
rules: The manifest includes every app in the canonical reviewed ecosystem ledger exactly once.
Every per-app audit export is generated at the same explicit asOf timestamp.
Manifest entries are sorted lexicographically by appId.
Each entry binds appId, repository, per-app exportSha256, reviewed commit, observed deployment commit/state and checkpoint-integrity state.
The manifest SHA-256 is computed over the complete manifest body excluding manifestSha256.
Repeated generation at the same asOf over unchanged Defence state must produce the same manifest and manifestSha256.
The manifest is compact: it references per-app audit-export hashes rather than embedding all eleven full audit bundles.
The manifest mutates nothing and grants no review, deployment, candidate, checklist or certification authority.
nonClaims: The manifest is a deterministic internal integrity fingerprint, not external notarisation.
A matching manifest proves the recorded estate snapshot is unchanged relative to its inputs; it does not prove every app is secure.
Different manifest hashes identify a changed recorded snapshot but do not by themselves explain whether the change is good, bad or expected.
